title: PCA UE · EDR Ingestion
description: Docker Swarm PCA UE EDR ingestion using shared pvstorage_* metrics restricted to inserter="pcaue_inserter": scrape health, tenant/schema row and dataset counters, dedicated attempt/stage timings, in-progress writes, batch size, Kafka lag, and ClickHouse pressure. Supports Analytics Lite without Spark or Druid.

options.content:
# PCA UE · EDR ingestion on Docker Swarm

Fedex → Kafka `pcaue.<tenant UUID>.<schema>.json` → PVStorage `--pcaueni` → ClickHouse.

**Start with scrape health:** UP confirms telemetry availability, not successful end-to-end ingestion. `No counter yet` is normal before the first event; Kafka offset `-1` means unknown.

Queries use shared `pvstorage_*` metrics restricted to `inserter="pcaue_inserter"`; write diagnostics require `pv-back#1986`.

panels.title: PCA UE inserter scrapes
panels.description: Worst current scrape state across this component's configured targets. No result means no matching jobs, not healthy. Independent of tenant/schema filters; up measures scrape availability only.

targets.expr: min(up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"})

panels.title: Kafka topic exporter scrape
panels.description: Worst current scrape state across this component's configured targets. No result means no matching jobs, not healthy. Independent of tenant/schema filters; up measures scrape availability only.

targets.expr: min(up{job="kafka-topic-metrics"})

panels.title: ClickHouse native scrapes
panels.description: Worst current scrape state across this component's configured targets. No result means no matching jobs, not healthy. Independent of tenant/schema filters; up measures scrape availability only.

targets.expr: min(up{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"})

panels.title: ClickHouse table exporter scrapes
panels.description: Worst current scrape state across this component's configured targets. No result means no matching jobs, not healthy. Independent of tenant/schema filters; up measures scrape availability only.

targets.expr: min(up{job=~"ch_prometheus_exporter.*"})

panels.title: Scrape state by target
panels.description: 0 = failed scrape, 1 = successful scrape. Missing targets leave a gap; inspect Prometheus /targets and the deployed profile. Includes Prometheus self-scrape.

targets.expr: up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*|kafka-topic-metrics|clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+|ch_prometheus_exporter.*|prometheus"}

panels.title: EDR rows inserted / second
panels.description: Successful inserted EDR rows per second, summed over inserters, scoped by tenant/schema. Counter starts on the first successful insert. A zero rate can be normal when idle. Only currently UP inserters contribute; compare the health panels before interpreting a partial total.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_inserted_rows_total{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: Datasets inserted / second
panels.description: Successful dataset insertions per second (batches, not Kafka messages or EDR rows). Lazily initialized after the first insert; UP inserters only.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_inserted_datasets_total{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: Failed dataset insert attempts · current counters
panels.description: Current cumulative insertion failures across UP inserters, including failed retry attempts; not permanently lost datasets. Each process restart resets its counter. The raw count makes the first-ever failure visible even when rate cannot observe a prior zero sample. Missing counter before the first failure is normal. Inspect inserter logs and ClickHouse pressure when this increases.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, schema) (pvstorage_invalid_datasets_total{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"} and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: PCA UE insert attempts / second · by result
panels.description: Completed PCA UE insertion attempts per second, split by success/error. A retry is another attempt; errors include cancellation and can include input rejection, readiness or ClickHouse failures. This is not a malformed-row count or permanently lost datasets. First-ever errors are also shown by the current failed-attempt counter. Requires the instrumented PVStorage image; older images expose no series.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, schema, result) (rate(pvstorage_insert_attempts_total{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag · messages
panels.description: Sum of non-negative lag over partitions for selected PCA UE topics/groups. Kafka message counts differ from EDR row counts. Read with the uncommitted-partition panel: no committed offset (-1) makes lag unknown. Only currently UP topic exporters contribute.

targets.expr: sum by (consumergroup, topic) ((kafka_consumergroup_lag{job="kafka-topic-metrics",topic=~"pcaue[.](${tenant:regex})[.](${schema:regex})[.]json",consumergroup=~"${consumerGroup:regex}"} >= 0) and on (job, instance, consumergroup, topic, partition) (kafka_consumergroup_current_offset{job="kafka-topic-metrics",topic=~"pcaue[.](${tenant:regex})[.](${schema:regex})[.]json",consumergroup=~"${consumerGroup:regex}"} >= 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="kafka-topic-metrics"} == 1))

panels.title: PCA UE Kafka topic offset movement / second
panels.description: Positive movement of the partition end offsets, summed by PCA UE topic. Offsets are gauges, so this uses deriv rather than counter rate; topic recreation/offset resets can make this estimate inaccurate. This is Kafka messages per second, not EDR rows or network bytes.

targets.expr: sum by (topic) (clamp_min(deriv(kafka_topic_partition_current_offset{job="kafka-topic-metrics",topic=~"pcaue[.](${tenant:regex})[.](${schema:regex})[.]json"}[$__rate_interval]), 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="kafka-topic-metrics"} == 1))

panels.title: Kafka partitions with no committed consumer offset
panels.description: Number of partitions reporting offset -1. Nonzero means consumer progress/lag cannot yet be established for those partitions. No series may mean the group has not registered, an exporter problem, or no topics; it is not a zero-lag guarantee.

targets.expr: sum by (consumergroup, topic) ((kafka_consumergroup_current_offset{job="kafka-topic-metrics",topic=~"pcaue[.](${tenant:regex})[.](${schema:regex})[.]json",consumergroup=~"${consumerGroup:regex}"} < bool 0) and on (job, instance) (up{job="kafka-topic-metrics"} == 1))

panels.title: ClickHouse exporter query failures / second
panels.description: Exporter HTTP scrape can be UP even when its database queries fail. Rising failures require investigation of credentials, ClickHouse reachability and exporter query support. Deployment-wide; not filtered by tenant or schema.

targets.expr: (rate(ClickHousePVX_exporter_scrape_failures_total{job=~"ch_prometheus_exporter.*"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"ch_prometheus_exporter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: ClickHouse tracked memory · all databases
panels.description: Current ClickHouse tracked memory per node, across all databases. This is backend pressure, not PCA UE tenant memory attribution.

targets.expr: (ClickHouseMetrics_MemoryTracking{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} == 1))

panels.title: ClickHouse background merges · all databases
panels.description: Currently running background merges per node, across all databases. High merge load with rising Kafka lag can indicate storage pressure. Follow the ClickHouse data/cluster analysis links for table parts and disk detail.

targets.expr: (ClickHouseMetrics_Merge{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} == 1))

panels.title: PCA UE table storage · bytes per replica
panels.description: Bytes in active system.parts for the pcaueni database, one series per table and replica. Schema selects tables; tenant does not filter this panel because these metrics have no tenant label. Do not sum replicas as logical storage. Check exporter query failures too: a reachable exporter can retain a previous table gauge after a failed collection.

targets.expr: (ClickHousePVX_table_parts_bytes{job=~"ch_prometheus_exporter.*",database="pcaueni",table=~"${schema:regex}"} and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"ch_prometheus_exporter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: ClickHouse default disk used · per node
panels.description: Used percentage of the default ClickHouse disk per node, across all databases. On a one-VM lab, multiple replicas can report the same underlying disk. Never sum these percentages. Tenant/schema filters do not apply.

targets.expr: (100 * (1 - ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_default{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} / (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskTotal_default{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} > 0))) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"clickhouse[0-9]+[a-z]+"} == 1)

panels.title: PCA UE completed attempt duration · p95
panels.description: Estimated p95 duration of completed success/error attempts, including open, readiness waits, ClickHouse write and close. Retries are separate attempts. Histogram buckets are summed across currently UP inserters for the selected tenant/schema. An idle rate window is empty, not zero; open attempts are only visible in the in-progress gauge. Requires instrumented PVStorage.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))) and on (tenant_id, schema) (sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_duration_seconds_count{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: PCA UE ClickHouse write duration · p95
panels.description: Estimated p95 of completed ClickHouse client.execute calls, including successful and failed calls. Excludes readiness waits, opening/closing input and Kafka transport. Empty when no write call completed in the rate window. Requires instrumented PVStorage.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}",stage="write"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))) and on (tenant_id, schema) (sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_stage_duration_seconds_count{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}",stage="write"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: PCA UE readiness waits · p95
panels.description: Estimated p95 of the table-existence, write-access and merge-partition readiness checks combined, including failures. No write-stage observation exists when readiness fails before the write. Empty when idle. Requires instrumented PVStorage.

defaults.noValue: No completed readiness checks in window

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}",stage="readiness"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))) and on (tenant_id, schema) (sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_stage_duration_seconds_count{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}",stage="readiness"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: PCA UE inserts in progress
panels.description: Current insertion attempts in progress across UP inserters. The gauge is initialized for a tenant/schema at its first attempt and returns to zero after success/error, including cancellation. It is not Kafka backlog or a queued-dataset count. Requires instrumented PVStorage.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant_id, schema) (pvstorage_insert_in_progress{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"} and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))

panels.title: PCA UE mean successful batch · EDR rows
panels.description: Mean ClickHouse-reported written rows per successful insertion attempt in the rate window: rate(histogram sum) / rate(histogram count). A successful zero-row write contributes zero; failed attempts do not contribute. Does not parse or count individual malformed input rows. No completed successful batch leaves the panel empty. Requires instrumented PVStorage.

targets.expr: (sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_batch_rows_sum{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1))) / (sum by (tenant_id, schema) (rate(pvstorage_insert_batch_rows_count{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*",inserter="pcaue_inserter",tenant_id=~"${tenant:regex}",schema=~"${schema:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"pcaueni_inserter.*"} == 1)) > 0)
